newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rejects India's drone intrusion charge.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rejects India's drone intrusion charge.

text.p: Pakistan on Thursday dismissed an Indian charge of intrusion by a remote-controlled aircraft last week and said no Pakistani plane had been in the area where New Delhi says the incident happened.

India lodged a strong protest and accused Pakistan last Thursday of committing an "unfriendly act" by sending the drone into the western state of Gujarat on the previous day, which the Indian Air Force fired at.
"No Pakistani plane, pilotless or otherwise, was in that area and we are not aware of what the Indian Air Force fired at," a Pakistan Foreign Ministry spokesman told reporters.
He also said that no civilian Pakistani plane had been in the area.
India and Pakistan have fought three wars since they were carved out of British India in 1947.
Troops on both sides of the frontier regularly fire on each other in the disputed northern region of Kashmir, which was the cause of two of the three wars.
